triage_cloud_model.description: Cloud fallback model for triage when Gemini Nano isn't available

deep_check_model.description: Model for the deep check (URL context; used when no template ID is set)

deep_check_template_id.description: Server prompt template ID for the deep check. Empty = send the prompt from the client

flag_threshold.description: Heuristic risk score at which a 'safe' model verdict is raised to 'suspicious'

auto_deep_check.description: Run the deep check automatically on suspicious pages

deep_check_fallback_model.description: Used if the deep check model stays overloaded after retries

deep_check_search.description: Add Google Search grounding to the deep check. Needs a billing-enabled project (free tier returns 429)
